text:
sam_marketing: Heads up team — pushing the benchmark webinar posts tomorrow morning. Need final confirmation on (1) hero + 2 alt images, (2) 4 X copy variants (one teaser, two hook+value, one CTA), (3) 2 LinkedIn long forms, (4) RSVP link w/ UTMs, and (5) lead routing plan. Can we lock by EOD today?

jess_growth: Proposed UTM template: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_content={variant}. I'll fill variant names after we choose copy. Paid boost: $1k total, split across top 2 performing X variants.

mike_design: Uploading assets to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/bench-webinar-2. Two alt images: one portrait for X image card, one landscape for LinkedIn. I'll compress carousel images to keep <500KB.

sam_marketing: Great. For copy, I sketched four short X options and two LI long drafts in the doc. Quick preview: 
- teaser: "Benchmarks out. See how inference speed and cost trade off. Live Wed — save your seat."
- hook: "Teams are cutting inference $ by half without latency loss. Our benchmark shows how."
- benefit: "Lower cost, consistent latency. Join our panel + live results."
- CTA: "Register now — limited seats."

anya_cs: For inbound, we can either route to Intercom or HubSpot. HubSpot allows immediate lead scoring via forms. If we use Intercom, add rule to tag conversations with 'webinar-bench' and forward high-intent messages.

luca_analytics: I'm setting up UTM parity so clicks map back to campaign dashboard. Suggest we include &variant=teaser|hook|benefit|cta and then A/B test impressions -> registrants -> demo requests.

scheduler_bot: Drafted post times: X @ 09:00 PT, X (reminder) @ 12:30 PT, LI @ 09:05 PT. Preview links: https://sched.example/p/1777 and https://sched.example/p/1778

jess_growth: Routing idea: Use Zapier: Intercom conversation -> filter for tag == 'webinar-bench' -> if regex(/pricing|demo|enterprise|SLA/i) then create HubSpot contact + set lifecycle=lead and owner = "CS team" -> else add to nurture list. Example filter: 
```
if contains(text, /pricing|demo|SLA|pricing request/i):
  create_hubspot_contact()
else:
  add_to_nurture()
```

mike_design: Two small copy asks: 1) Please avoid acronyms in LI long copy, 2) make first line a clear value hook for mobile.

sam_marketing: Noted. Also we need microcopy for paid CTA button: "Reserve my seat" vs "Register free". Which wins?

luca_analytics: "Reserve my seat" has slightly higher CTR historically. Go with that for paid, but A/B with "Register free" organically. I'll tag variants in the dashboard.

anya_cs: If someone RSVPs with a corporate email and asks for pricing/demo, mark as hot and notify #cs-inbound. We'll export hot signups CSV hourly during the campaign.

scheduler_bot: Posts queued. Will publish at scheduled times and post a summary in this thread with impressions + link clicks after send.

sam_marketing: Sweet. Everyone drop final asset links + confirm routing by 5pm PT. If anything blocks, flag it now. Thanks! :raised_hands:
